citations.title: UAEU Counseling and Wellbeing
citations.sourceSection: Procedure; conditions; confidentiality FAQ and separate academic-record FAQ
citations.evidenceText: Counseling and Wellbeing is free for UAEU students. Appointment channels are the booking system, walk-in office or email. The page lists 800 8238 for assistance; it does not confirm direct appointment booking on that number. Assessment determines support; typically 6–8 sessions of 45–60 minutes. Insurance is required for psychiatry referral. Counseling attendance is not added to the academic record. Separately, disclosure normally requires prior written consent, with stated confidentiality exceptions for danger to self/others and sexual abuse/harassment of children. These exceptions do not mean counseling is added to academic records. The catalog lists 1 hour delivery and no required document.

citations.title: UAEU BSc Information Security — Degree Requirements
citations.sourceSection: Degree Requirements, Internship footnote, Elective Courses
citations.evidenceText:
BSc Information Security — published 120-credit curriculum
- The structure is 21 general-education, 41 college, 46 major, 6 internship and 6 major-elective credits.
- Major courses include ISEC311/321 Network Security I/II, ISEC312 Cryptography, ISEC322 Security Protocols, ISEC323 Secure Software Design, ISEC411 Privacy and Anonymity, ISEC412 Digital Forensics, ISEC413 Security Architecture, ISEC421 Risk Analysis and Management, and ISEC422 Security Policy, Laws, and Governance, with ISEC324/414/423 labs. Other required major courses include CSBP320, CSBP121, CENG210, ITBP301, CSBP221 and CSBP340.
- Choose two major electives from ISEC416, ISEC417, ISEC424, ISEC428 and ITBP280. ITBP480/481 senior projects are college requirements.
- ITBP496 Internship is 6 credits in the last semester; the program does not allow other courses during internship. Your cohort and remaining requirements determine your own semester plan.

productionBlockers: Managed university identity is not integrated
Shared server-side quotas and rate limits are not integrated

retrieval.canonicalRendering: prepared answers, workflow evidence and retrieved excerpts feed tailored source-checked generation; structured checklist UI and system notices remain deterministic
retrieval.groundingChecks: source-id-and-critical-token-validation plus same-provider per-claim source-support review; up to two checked rewrites; not-formal-entailment-proof

hybridCorpus.mode: SQLite FTS5 BM25 + dense cosine + reciprocal rank fusion + deterministic metadata/facet/diversity reranking

usage.limitation: Missing diagnostics are not zero cost. Only provider-returned usage is measurable.
